label: Current-year payment difficulty
description: Resident is struggling to keep up with current-year instalments. No formal recovery stage is yet clear.

label: Missed instalment / reminder-stage difficulty
description: Resident has missed one or more instalments or mentions a reminder notice.

label: Final notice concern
description: Resident says they have lost the right to instalments or have been told the whole year's balance is due.

label: Summons / liability-order-stage concern
description: Resident mentions summons, court, liability order, or similar higher-risk recovery stage.

label: Existing arrears with request for help
description: Resident acknowledges arrears and wants help, an arrangement, or a clearer next step.

label: Payment difficulty with likely support route
description: Resident's answers suggest support-related signposting may be relevant (Council Tax Reduction, discounts, debt advice).

label: Payment difficulty with vulnerability-sensitive handling need
description: Resident's answers suggest the call should be handled with extra care and potentially routed differently.

label: Wrong queue / outside scope
description: The issue is not primarily a council tax payment-difficulty call and should be redirected or ended safely.
